title: Captain Necin's raid
summary: Capture and defend two camps with Captain Necin and Sergeant Cursah.
overview: Show Necin the completed soldier's chest to receive a map, then return the map when the force is ready. Follow him and Cursah to the two camps.
Both camps must be clear before counterattacks begin. After an initial 30-to-60-second delay, waves arrive every minute: four grimlings at the smaller camp and six at the larger camp.

phases.label: Capture both camps
phases.description: The event resets camp spawns. Clear both positions rather than relying on a pre-clear.

phases.label: Defend both leaders
phases.description: Protect Necin and Cursah while reinforcement waves arrive. Either leader's death fails the assault.

phases.label: Find the officer
phases.description: The officer may appear at either camp. Waves stop when it arrives; kill it and return proof to Necin.

sections.title: Entry requirements
paragraphs: The soldier's chest is exchanged for the map used to begin the raid.
